build_DeformableDETRHead: build a DeformableDETRHead instance with configurable prediction layers and two-stage mode
init_DeformableDETRHead_weights: initialize the classification and regression branch weights of a DeformableDETRHead model
run_DeformableDETRHead_forward: run the forward pass of DeformableDETRHead to get classification scores and bounding box predictions
compute_DeformableDETRHead_loss: compute the detection loss for DeformableDETRHead including encoder proposal losses in two-stage mode
predict_DeformableDETRHead_instances: predict object instances using DeformableDETRHead with optional rescaling to original image space
